crossRefs.note: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household, who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it…
So they took him, and threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
They threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin…

parallels.note: So they took him, and threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
They threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

translations.web: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
translations.bsb: So they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
translations.kjv: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
translations.asv: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard.
